scope: Source-based coverage proposal, not a replacement for project-status or a verified acceptance report.

statusDefinitions.review: Concrete implementation available for review; does not mean integrated, played or PRD-complete.
statusDefinitions.in_progress: Partial prototype, draft or integration exists; listed requirements still missing.
statusDefinitions.deferred: Not implemented in inspected slice; remains in backlog, not an approved scope cut.

evidencePolicy: Source symbols prove implementation presence only.
Typecheck and logic smoke checks do not verify gameplay, timing, emotional impact or assets.
Do not derive overall completion from file count, scene names, dialogue count or an arbitrary percentage.
User-approved language and first-person/interactive maze constraints supplement the PRD.
